interface.shortDescription: Reflect, then take a next step
interface.longDescription: Use memories and past chats your connected assistant can access to review strengths and likely answers grounded in examples, then ask only consequential gaps. Kimi Code is an evaluation/setup path, not a supported host; this does not claim a direct Kimi.ai consumer archive. Stored-data reads require the applicable consent and an explicit source choice for the session. Free and noncommercial; not diagnosis or treatment.
